description: Reusable minimal real-QVT 2-D ICP electron particle + electron-energy diffusion diagnostic with solved mean energy and energy-dependent transport lookup.
objective: Establish the next reusable layer after fixed-energy diffusion: solve conservative electron energy and use the resulting mean_en to look up electron transport.
target_claims: electron particle and electron-energy diffusion run together on the real ICP RZ plasma geometry without electrostatic coupling
solved mean electron energy drives local electron diffusivity through the production electron_moments.txt lookup
particle and electron-energy wall losses use the same zero-potential grounded thermal/sheath branch
constraints: electron particle continuity solved in log-molar form
electron energy density solved as c_epsilon in eV mol/m^3
mean electron energy derived dynamically as c_epsilon/c_e
electron particle and energy diffusivities obtained from electron_moments.txt through PhysicsElectronClosureMaterial
Joule heating and volumetric electron-energy sources disabled
all named plasma boundaries use matched grounded thermal particle/energy collection with sheath potential fixed to 0 V
no electric field or volumetric source

provenance.purpose: cross-issue reusable 2-D ICP troubleshooting baseline after fixed-energy diffusion
